findings.title: SDK materializes absent optional fields as null
findings.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs may expose missing usage/model as null rather than omitting keys. Compatibility evidence treats null as unavailable and does not fabricate zeros or copy requested model.

findings.title: Provenance decision B — additive endpoint_boundary
findings.summary: Existing nine-term central provenance vocabulary is not mutated. Endpoint-owned fields use additive endpoint_boundary ownership in compatibility artifacts.
